summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII (f/k/a Columbus Circle Capital Corp II), a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting to change the company name and amend its articles accordingly. The name change proposal passed with 20,065,870 votes for, 9,509 against, and 4 abstentions, out of 20,075,383 shares present (64.07% quorum). This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation. No deal terms, pricing, or strategic events are involved. The filing is administrative, with no impact on the company's SPAC status or operations. Watch for any subsequent business combination announcements, as the name change may precede a target announcement.
